title: "Guides"

Choose a path after the [quickstart](../quickstart.qmd). These pages explain
the numerical contract behind each operation; the [API reference](../api/index.qmd)
lists every signature and parameter.

| If you need to... | Start with | Result scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Estimate local level or scatter | [Neighborhood statistics](semantics.qmd) | Every output position is filtered. |
| Check measured cost and limits | [Benchmark evidence](benchmarks.qmd) | Recorded measurements show scope. |

## Suggested reading path

1. Follow the [quickstart](../quickstart.qmd) using small NumPy arrays.
2. Read the guide for the operation you selected.
3. Open the matching [API section](../api/index.qmd) for the exact call.
4. Check [benchmark evidence](benchmarks.qmd) before making performance claims.

The guides follow the repository's `main` branch and can describe source-build
behavior that is not yet on PyPI.

## More operations

After the neighborhood-statistic examples, use these guides for additional
operations. Each retains its own numerical contract.

| Task | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| Apply a kernel or smooth missing data | [Convolution and Gaussian filters](convolution.qmd) |
| Build Moffat, Student-t, top-hat, or ring kernels | [N-dimensional kernels](kernels.qmd) |
| Estimate a local mode or robust level | [Robust statistics](robust.qmd) |
| Find edges or remove compact features | [Edges and morphology](morphology.qmd) |
| Change only known bad pixels | [Masked-pixel repair](fixpix.qmd) |
